# Vendored QuickJS

Unmodified library sources from QuickJS 2026-06-04, by Fabrice Bellard and
Charlie Gordon, licensed under MIT (see `LICENSE`). Command-line tools and
the libc/OS bindings are intentionally not linked into Tompouce.

Source: https://bellard.org/quickjs/quickjs-2026-06-04.tar.xz

Archive SHA-256:
`b376e839b322978313d929fd20663b11ba58b75df5a46c126dd19ea2fa70ad2a`

The application sets explicit memory, stack, and execution-time limits and
provides only its console, slider, and bundled-module host interfaces.
